name: Cerebrum Magnum
tag: Pulls your organization's knowledge into one place, then gives AI agents the context to carry out real work.

scenarios.title: Weekly organization brief
scenarios.ask: Give me a weekly brief for our {org} of {people} people, with the top issues and who owns them.
steps: Knowledge reader
Read this week's updates from {sources} sources: email threads, shared drives, tasks and finance.
Analyst
Found {=3 + round(sources / 2)} issues worth attention, such as a supplier price rise and two stalled tasks.
Owner matcher
Linked each issue to its likely owner using past work.
Executor
Drafted the next action for each, ready to assign.
followups: Does it work differently for a nonprofit?
The brief adds grant deadlines, donor follow-ups and board items for nonprofits, and investor updates for startups. The core is the same.
You set it. Leaders can get the full brief and teams get only their own items.

scenarios.title: Capture know-how before someone retires
scenarios.ask: Our operations lead retires in {months}. Capture what they know so the next person can pick it up.
steps: Interviewer
Scheduled {=ceil(processes / 3)} short recorded interviews, 3 processes each.
Knowledge reader
Pulled related emails, files and checklists for each process.
Writer
Turned each interview into a step-by-step guide with the who, when and why.
Agent builder
Set up an assistant the successor can ask questions, answering from those guides.
followups: What if they can't spare the time?
Interviews are 30 minutes and the agent drafts from their files first, so they mostly confirm and correct.
Can family members in the business use it too?
Yes. Anyone you add can ask the assistant, and private items stay with the people you choose.

scenarios.title: Prepare a board meeting
scenarios.ask: Prepare our board pack for next month: {items} agenda items and {members} board members.
steps: Collector
Gathered the numbers, minutes and open actions from last meeting.
Writer
Drafted a one-page summary for each of {items} items.
Checker
Found {=max(1, round(items / 3))} open actions from last time still not done and listed owners.
Scheduler
Sent the pack and a poll for dates to {members} members.
followups: Yes. It can draft minutes from a recording or notes, and a person approves them before they're shared.
